name: draw.io
description: Create and edit local, editable .drawio flowcharts, architecture diagrams and ER diagrams. Includes XML references and checks; PNG, SVG and PDF export requires an existing draw.io Desktop installation. No hosted MCP or web viewer.
examples: Create login-flow.drawio with password validation, a two-factor check and success/failure branches.
Draw a browser, API, job queue, worker and database architecture in system.drawio; export SVG if draw.io Desktop is available.
Add a Shipments entity to shop.drawio, linked to Orders, preserving the existing layout.

zh-CN.name: draw.io
zh-CN.description: 创建和编辑本地可继续打开的 .drawio 流程图、架构图与 ER 图。内置 XML 参考和检查；导出 PNG、SVG、PDF 需要已安装的 draw.io Desktop。不接云端 MCP 或网页查看器。
examples: 创建 login-flow.drawio，包含密码校验、双因素验证及成功和失败分支。
将浏览器、API、任务队列、Worker 和数据库画成 system.drawio 架构图；有 draw.io Desktop 时导出 SVG。
在 shop.drawio 中添加 Shipments 实体，关联 Orders，保留现有布局。
